name: Colinet
source:
75 year old (looks way younger and is in much better shape then he should be thanks to magic) sorcerer and Nova's adoptive father.
Wanted to spend his old years in peace and quiet but then a small naga hatched from an egg he was left with.

[From [url=https://animefanka.itch.io/coiled-up-together]itch.io[/url]]
